paras.text: … is by a majority of votes, while in important matters the vote of the five permanent members is necessary. Even one permanent member has the authority to give a negative vote, which is called the right of veto (Veto). Its important work is to ensure world peace and security. If it is proved that some member country has committed aggression, then against that country either economic sanctions are imposed or military action is taken.

sections.theory:
… is by a majority of votes, while in important matters the vote of the five permanent members is necessary. Even one permanent member has the authority to give a negative vote, which is called the right of veto (Veto). Its important work is to ensure world peace and security. If it is proved that some member country has committed aggression, then against that country either economic sanctions are imposed or military action is taken.

Instructions for the activity:

Holding a session on the pattern of the UN General Assembly:

1. Imagine the whole class as the General Assembly of the United Nations. Elect the president by simple majority.

2. Hold the session under the presidency of the elected president. Every member should speak with the permission of the president.

3. Start a debate on any world topic, e.g. the problem of world environmental pollution. Every member is allowed to speak. Every aspect of the problem should be discussed.

4. Winding up the debate, prepare recommendations. Vote on these recommendations. If the majority supports these recommendations, present them to the Security Council or the member countries.

Holding a session on the pattern of the Security Council:

1. Bring fifteen students forward in the class. Nominate five of them as permanent members.

2. This council should elect a president from among its members.

3. Start the session under the chairmanship of the president. The president should tell the council on what topic the debate is to be held today. Begin a debate on any such world topic as is a threat to peace, for example the issue of Kashmir or Palestine. First decide whether this is an ordinary matter or a special one. Then determine the aggressor country.

4. After the debate, vote for economic or military action against the aggressor country. If this is an ordinary matter, the decision should be by any nine or more votes. If it is a special matter, then too the decision should be by nine votes, but among these nine the positive vote of all the permanent members must be included. Even one permanent member has the authority to give a negative vote, which is called the right of veto (Veto). Its important work is to ensure world peace and security. If it is proved that some member country has committed aggression, then against that country either economic sanctions are imposed or military action is taken.

Instructions for the activity:

Holding a session on the pattern of the UN General Assembly:

1. Imagine the whole class as the General Assembly of the United Nations. Elect the president by simple majority.

2. Hold the session under the presidency of the elected president. Every member should speak with the permission of the president.

3. Start a debate on any world topic, e.g. the problem of world environmental pollution. Every member is allowed to speak. Every aspect of the problem should be discussed.

4. Winding up the debate, prepare recommendations. Vote on these recommendations. If the majority supports these recommendations, present them to the Security Council or the member countries.

Holding a session on the pattern of the Security Council:

1. Bring fifteen students forward in the class. Nominate five of them as permanent members.

2. This council should elect a president from among its members.

3. Start the session under the chairmanship of the president. The president should tell the council on what topic the debate is to be held today. Begin a debate on any such world topic as is a threat to peace, for example the issue of Kashmir or Palestine. First decide whether this is an ordinary matter or a special one. Then determine the aggressor country.

4. After the debate, vote for economic or military action against the aggressor country. If this is an ordinary matter, the decision should be by any nine or more votes. paras.text: A public service announcement is a kind of advertisement which is presented through TV, radio or print media etc. The purpose of a standard public service message is to identify those problems in which awareness can be given to the public. Through it change can be brought in public attitudes. Historically, the public service announcement or public service message in its present form was started by the War Advertising Council during the Second World War. Through these advertisements the American public was to be taken into confidence about the different fronts of the war. After the war this council widened its plan of action further, and forest fires, blood donations and the safety of highways etc. were included in it. After a few years public service messages became more common on TV and radio. Today the preparation of this kind of message has been given the status of an industry, and it is also an important means of earning for the media.

These messages are an essential part of awareness campaigns, and with time their topics keep increasing steadily. An example of this kind of message is also: “To protect your beloved earth, keep it green.” The support of public service messages can be taken about religious, cultural, social, political, legal, moral and military etc. matters. پبلک سروس اِعلان ایک قسم کا اِشتہار ہے جو ٹی وی، ریڈیو یا پرنٹ میڈیا وغیرہ کے ذریعے پیش کیا جاتا ہے۔ ایک معیاری پبلک سروس میسج کا مقصد اُن مسائل کی نشاندہی ہے جن میں عوام کو آگہی دی جا سکتی ہے۔ اِس کے ذریعے عوامی رویوں میں تبدیلی لائی جا سکتی ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر پبلک سروس اِعلان یا پبلک سروس میسج اپنی موجودہ حالت میں جنگ کے اِشتہاری کونسل نے دوسری جنگِ عظیم کے دوران شروع کیا۔ اِن اِشتہارات کے ذریعے امریکی عوام کو جنگ کے مختلف محاذوں کے بارے میں اعتماد میں لینا تھا۔ جنگ کے بعد اِس کونسل نے اپنا لائحہ عمل اور بھی وسیع کر دیا اور اِس میں جنگلات کی آگ، خون کے عطیات اور شاہراہوں کی حفاظت وغیرہ کو شامل کر دیا گیا۔ چند سالوں کے بعد پبلک سروس میسج ٹی وی اور ریڈیو پر مزید عام ہو گئے۔ آج تو اِس قسم کے پیغامات کی تیاری کو ایک صنعت کا درجہ دیا گیا ہے اور یہ میڈیا کی کمائی کا ایک اہم ذریعہ بھی ہے۔

پبلک سروس میسج کے اہم موضوعات میں صحت اور تحفظ کو اہمیت حاصل ہے۔ یہ پیغامات بیداری مہمات کا لازمی حصہ ہیں اور وقت کے ساتھ ساتھ اِس کے موضوعات میں برابر اضافہ ہوتا جا رہا ہے۔ اِس قسم کے پیغامات کی ایک مثال یہ بھی ہے کہ ”اپنی پیاری زمین کے تحفظ کیلئے اِسے سرسبز رکھو۔“ مذہبی، ثقافتی، سماجی، سیاسی، قانونی، اخلاقی اور فوجی وغیرہ معاملات کے بارے میں پبلک سروس میسج کا سہارا لیا جا سکتا ہے۔ اِس پیغام کی تیاری میں کئی چیزوں کو مدِنظر رکھنا پڑتا ہے مثلاً مؤثر الفاظ کا چناؤ، بہترین آوازوں اور شکلوں کا اِنتخاب اور مؤثر پس منظر کا اِنتخاب وغیرہ۔
